conventions.field: one complex four-component massless Dirac field; both sphere signs included
conventions.local_counterterms: same local geometric terms and anomaly cancel in this spin-structure difference; absolute AP stress remains unspecified
conventions.observable: Delta=periodic minus antiperiodic on exactly the same local metric
conventions.regulator: spatial lattice and angular truncation removed by independent convergence checks; not a physical covariant finite Lambda for nonconstant lapse
conventions.state: zero-temperature static ground state separately for each P/AP spin structure
conventions.topology: one smooth axial motif closed on S1; x is compact; different from unwrapped periodic array and compact transverse carrier y
conventions.units: hbar=c=1; r_min=1 is the declared throat-length unit

operator.HF_identity: d sum singular(A)=Re Tr[(U V_dagger)_polar_dagger dA]; vary every N_i,q_i,r_i before setting N=q=1
operator.continuum: H=-i sigma2[c partial_x+c'/2]+v sigma1; c=N/q, v=N*kappa/r

physical_connection: changing axial spin structure P to AP lowers the computed throat null source on the actual varying-radius profile by Delta(rho+p_x); no local-density substitution from the cylinder is used

reproduction_tolerance.reason: subtractive SVD vacuum energies and local gradients; accommodates numerical BLAS variation

smallest_absolute_stress_dependency: derive the complete 4D covariant proper-time determinant and adopted compensator's lapse/radial/sphere variations in the chosen AP state on this same metric; the varying-radius local curvature terms no longer have the product cylinder's null cancellation, so their action-defined coefficients must be retained rather than set by fitting a neck residual

required_Einstein_null_comparison.interpretation: AP lowers the null source relative to P, in the direction needed at the neck; Delta(P-AP) is not the absolute AP source, and G has not been fitted to equate magnitudes

smooth_families.tail_interpretation: higher angular contributions reach subtractive SVD roundoff; their sign is not promoted into an exact tail result
